ir.name: all_pairs_weighted_diff
ir.intuition: All winner/loser pairs by strict objective ordering, weighted by the positive difference in objective, with loser index first in pair tuple to satisfy winner/loser semantics.

ir.name: loss_diff_exp_advantage
ir.intuition: Parabolic penalization of log-probability difference with exponential sensitivity, aligned to cost_gap target
ir.pseudocode: gap = log_prob_w - log_prob_l; scaled_gap = alpha * gap; target_gap = alpha * cost_gap; clamp both; exp_term = exp(scaled_gap); target_exp = exp(target_gap); loss = weight * (exp_term - target_exp)^2; loss = mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    cost_gap = batch['cost_gap']
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    gap = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    scaled_gap = ops.mul(alpha, gap)
    scaled_gap = ops.clamp(scaled_gap, -10.0, 10.0)
    target_gap = ops.mul(alpha, cost_gap)
    target_gap = ops.clamp(target_gap, -10.0, 10.0)
    exp_term = ops.exp(scaled_gap)
    target_exp = ops.exp(target_gap)
    diff = ops.sub(exp_term, target_exp)
    loss = ops.mul(diff, diff)
    loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
